name: Crustation
description: A control panel for game servers. One binary supervises the server processes and serves a web interface, so there is no Docker socket to expose and everything lives in the three folders you map below. Early days: sign-in, the server list, start, stop, restart, kill, a live console you can type into, and host and per-process stats all work. Creating a server from the interface does not exist yet, so this suits you if you already have server files on disk or you enjoy watching a project grow. The roadmap is in the GitHub repository. First sign-in: set the admin username and password below, or leave them empty and read the generated password from first-login.txt in the config folder. Java 8, 17 and 21 are included for the game servers you run. Forward the game ports your servers need; 25565 and 19132 are mapped by default.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Database, settings and the first-login file.

paths.name: Servers
paths.description: Where game server files live. Put this on a share with room to grow.

ports.description: Port for the Crustation web interface.

ports.description: Default port for a Minecraft Bedrock server.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: Username for the first administrator. Only used on the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Password for the first administrator, at least 10 characters. Leave empty to have one generated into first-login.txt.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for logs and schedules, for example Europe/London.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id that owns the files. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id that owns the files. 100 is users on Unraid.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Full external address when behind a reverse proxy, for example https://panel.example.com. Turns on secure cookies.
